name: Everything Is LeetCode
effect: Suppressing this layer-2 neuron makes the model answer any prompt as if it were a LeetCode problem statement, usually about integer arrays, subarrays and target sums.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 37/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
